I understand you'd like to request a refund for booking JDK2XS, but unfortunately, I'm unable to process this request. 

Your current fare class is "basic," which is non-refundable according to our fare rules. Additionally, this fare type doesn't permit waivers to override its policies under any circumstances. Fares can only be waived when there's an airline-initiated schedule change, and your booking doesn't reflect such a change.

If you believe there may be exceptional circumstances warranting an exception, I'd be happy to transfer you to a human agent who can review your specific situation further.
